description: Adds the BlueIT Service settings menu to supported TikTok builds.
name: BlueIT Service

description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.
name: Copy comments without username

description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit of up to 500 videos.
name: Custom offline videos limit

description: Adds optional Morphe diagnostic logging, filtered reports, and local Java crash capture.
name: Diagnostic tools

description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.
name: Disable login requirement

description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.
name: Disable long-press quick share

description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.
name: Disable screen capture detection

description: Selects automatic, highest, or target video quality and lets BlueIT choose the preferred TikTok download stream.
name: Download quality selector

description: Adds watermark-free downloads, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.
name: Downloads

description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.
name: Enable Live search

description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.
name: Enable non-personalized search

description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.
name: Feature Gate Lab

description: Adds BlueIT Learn mode for recording newly observed TikTok configuration candidates while using a feature.
name: Feature Gate Recorder

description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.
name: Feed filter

description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.
name: Feed tab navigation

description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.
name: Fix Google login

description: Remaps TikTok feed single tap, double tap, left/right seek, and long-press gestures.
name: Gesture remapper

description: Keeps a local BlueIT watch-history and filters videos you already watched from newly loaded feed batches.
name: Hide already seen videos

description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.
name: Hide CAPTCHA popups

description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.
name: Hide floating promotions

description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.
name: Hide quick comment reactions

description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.
name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock

description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.
name: Open external links directly

description: Downloads the original Photo Mode CDN assets instead of keeping TikTok's rendered copies when enabled.
name: Original Photo Mode downloader

description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.
name: Playback speed

description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.
name: Remember clear display

description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.
name: Resume videos after scrolling

description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.
name: Show seekbar

description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.
name: Show seekbar thumbnail

description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup.
name: SIM spoof

description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.
name: Stop video looping

description: Experimental recovery opt-in: runtime-selectable BlueIT themes applied to TikTok TUX/Compose colors and classic surfaces.
name: Theme engine

options.description: Use TikTok's native centered profile header instead of the left-aligned experiment. Applies independently of the selected color preset.
options.title: Classic centered profile

options.description: Optional starting theme for a fresh install. This is only a default; the theme remains freely selectable in BlueIT settings afterwards.
options.title: Initial theme preset

description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.
name: Translate comments

description: Drops retrofit2 enqueue calls whose Request URL contains "/truth/ads".
name: Block ad requests at the network layer

description: Drops navigation to the Truth+ upsell sheet and the per-feature roadblock dialog.
name: Block Truth+ upsell

description: Skips Play Integrity assertion injection — chain proceeds with the original request.
name: Bypass Play Integrity

description: Forces the smsCountry == "US" check on premiumGateHelper.d(user) to always return true.
name: Bypass Truth+ geofence

description: Removes advertising-ID and ad-services permissions from the manifest.
name: Disable advertising ID

description: Neutralizes AppAnalyticsManager — every void-returning method becomes return-void.
name: Disable analytics

description: Neutralizes Firebase Analytics + Crashlytics logging methods.
name: Disable Firebase telemetry

description: Neutralizes SearchAIUseCase invocations.
name: Disable Search AI

description: Forces Features.tvEnabled to true on construction. Truth TV becomes visible across the app.
name: Enable Truth TV

description: Forces editsEnabled + editsVisible to true on Features and L6.U gates. Server may still reject.
name: Force enable Truth+ post editing

description: Forces scheduleEnabled + scheduleVisible to true on Features and L6.U gates. Server may still reject.
name: Force enable Truth+ post scheduling

description: Removes /truth/ads responses, AdQueueManager fetches and feed insertions.
name: Hide ads

description: Removes the Truth AI tab from the bottom navigation bar.
name: Hide AI tab

description: Drops feeds whose id is "for_you" or "recommended" from the FeedsRepositoryImpl reader.
name: Hide For You feed

description: Suppresses the Help Center row in the account drawer sidebar.
name: Hide Help Center sidebar item

description: Removes the livestream avatar carousel at the top of the home feed.
name: Hide live content carousel

description: Removes the sponsored "Proudly sponsored by Truth Social" card at the top of the home feed.
name: Hide top banner ad

description: Removes the gem badge and the Truth Gems banner / drawer button.
name: Hide Truth Gems

description: Removes the TRUTH+ upsell button from the top app bar.
name: Hide TRUTH+ button

description: Repackages to com.truthsocial.android.app.mtga so the patched APK coexists with the Play Store install.
name: Rename package to MTGA variant

description: Removes isSplitRequired / requiredSplitTypes / vending.splits.required so the patched APK installs standalone.
name: Strip split requirement

description: Appends "-mtga-patched" to the manifest versionName and inlined BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME literals.
name: Tag versionName with -mtga-patched

description: This is an example patch to start with.
name: Example Patch

description: Replaces Sofascore's bundled regular sans font with Google Sans Code NFP Regular.
name: Use Google Sans Code for Sofascore

description: Prevents the app from detecting specific keyboards.
name: Disable Keyboard Discrimination

description: Disables root detection checks in MobilKincstár.
name: Disable Root Detection

description: Allows taking screenshots and screen recording in MobilKincstár.
name: Disable Screenshot Protection

description: Disables SSL certificate pinning in MobilKincstár, allowing traffic interception.
name: Disable SSL Pinning

description: Hides banner, native, interstitial and sponsored ad tiles by treating the user as ad-free, the same state a Chefkoch PLUS subscriber has. Also skips the ad-consent (CMP) prompt.
name: Remove ads

description: Drops Firebase Analytics events and user properties before they leave the app. Other telemetry (Snowplow, Audix) is handled by the Remove tracking patch.
name: Remove analytics

description: Neuters the app tracking middleware: no Snowplow events, no Admo Audix targeting and no Firebase tracking state changes are processed.
name: Remove tracking

description: Standalone VOT add-on for official ReVanced 6.2.1 and YouTube 20.40.45. Select the official patches, including background playback, in the same run.
name: Add VOT (voice-over translation)

description: Blocks remote and cached network policies that add TLS trust anchors or override API and static-content hosts.
name: Block remote network policy

description: Removes ad providers, sanitizes ad identifiers, returns an empty ad list, and keeps advertising consent disabled.
name: Disable advertisements

description: Disables audited analytics transports and replaces the stable request device identifier.
name: Disable analytics and trackers

description: Disables audited boot, network-state, VPN, and Connect session hooks.
name: Disable background hooks

description: Removes privileged install, location, storage, billing, USB, and vendor data access while preserving user-driven installs.
name: Disable invasive permissions

description: Disables periodic Kaspersky scheduling and reports disabled workers as successfully completed.
name: Disable Kaspersky background scan

description: Disables RuStore and VK push initialization, services, and audited push receivers.
name: Disable push services

description: Disables audited SMS, call, phone-state, SID, and Mail.ru verification hooks.
name: Disable verification hooks

description: Excludes only apps whose recorded Android installer is Google Play from update requests.
name: Exclude Google Play apps from update checks

description: Removes the gaming profile permission, hides the gaming profile widget, and blocks navigation to the gaming profile.
name: Hide gaming profile

description: Replaces the RuStore SDK device identifier sent with payment and session requests with the zero UUID.
name: Replace RuStore SDK device identifier

description: Replaces the VK SDK device fingerprint sent by VK ID and VK Pay request paths with the zero UUID.
name: Replace VK SDK device identifier

description: Adapts secure-session requests to RuStore 1.108 API changes for re-signed APKs.
name: Restore secure-session compatibility

description: Keeps only the workers required for automatic updates and allows update checks to run while RuStore is foreground or background.
name: Restrict background work to updates

description: Skips the update authentication suggestion and returns a valid completed result.
name: Skip update authentication

description: Collapses ad slots, blocks ad network traffic, and adds configurable User-Agent and restart controls.
name: ChMate ReVanced

description: Ensures the Tidal debug activity is exported in AndroidManifest.xml.
name: Export Debug Activity

description: Enables the internal debug menu in Tidal settings.
name: Unlock Debug Menu

description: Unlocks FirePass premium features in Skimboarding: spot filtering by skill level, advanced map features, and session log tools.
name: Unlock FirePass Premium

description: Unlocks all Soundbrenner Plus features and Home Customization.
name: Unlock Plus

description: Unlocks all premium features (search, speed reading, unlimited highlights).
name: Unlock Premium

description: Unlocks all premium wallpapers and removes license verification features.
name: Unlock Premium

description: Optional parallel installation with a default or custom package name. Without this patch the original package is retained. The app name is unchanged; providers, permissions and links are isolated when selected.
name: Change package name

options.description: Used only when this patch is selected. Keep the default to update an existing .morphe install with the same signing key. The app name is unchanged.
options.title: Package name

description: Complete the observed bus-update rewarded unit using its loaded reward metadata; retain the original fallback. Requires sideload startup compatibility, not package renaming.
name: RailsGo bus update without video

description: Required for supported re-signed standard or Shizuku installs, with or without package renaming. Bypasses the Java Play-license startup entry. Root mount is not qualified.
name: RailsGo sideload startup compatibility

description: Lets screenshots and screen recordings work wherever Instagram blocks them, like disappearing photos and videos in your chats.
name: Allow screenshots

description: Asks before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on a call button doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it and Cancel doesn't. Its switch starts off.
name: Ask before a call

description: Asks before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't. Continue goes ahead and Cancel doesn't. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.
name: Ask before a like

description: Asks before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so a stray pull keeps what's on screen. Refresh goes ahead, and Cancel stops the spinner. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.
name: Ask before a refresh

description: Plays an animation you pick, from the ones Instagram made for Instagram Rings creators, in the heart that pops up when you double tap a post. Its switch, under Reels, starts off.
name: Change the like animation

description: Raises this build's version code to the highest Android allows, so Google Play stops offering Meta's updates over it. Instagram's checks against the version it was built as still see the real one. Once it's in, going back to an unpatched Instagram means uninstalling first, which deletes Instagram's data on your phone, and later HushGram builds need this patch too or they won't install over this one.
name: Change version code

description: Hides the Follow button on reels, the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity with the comment preview, and the comment bar under a reposted reel. Each part has its own switch.
name: Clean up Reels

description: Once Instagram's cache holds more than 500 MB of images and videos, deletes the images when it goes to the background and the videos the next time it starts. A Clear now row shows what it freed. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay.
name: Clear the media cache

description: Adds an optional Copy action to the common comment menu. Copies the original text with its line breaks.
name: Copy comment
